t: Report On Mr. J. F. Lavies And Mrs. C.P.V. Lavies

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
POLICE REGISTRY
A. D. 846
5. 1. 32.

January 5 32.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. 3996 of November 27, 1931 and to inform you
that despite careful inquiries, no trace can be
found in Shanghai of either Mr. J.F. Lavies or
his wife Mrs. C.P.V. Lavies. They are not registered
at the local Belgian Consulate-General.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Assistant Commissioner (Special Branch).

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

REPORT
Date January 4, 1932.

Subject (in full) Mr. J.F. Lavies and Mrs. C.P.V.Lavies.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the attached letter of December 7,
from the Netherlands Consulate-General on the subject of
Mr.J.F. Lavies and Mrs.C.P.V.Lavies, diligent inquiries have
failed to trace either of these persons in Shanghai. They
are not registered at the local Belgium Consulate General.
In event of any information regarding these individuals being
obtained a report will be duly submitted.

（签名：G Tcheremshansky）
D. S.

ate 28. 11. 31.

SHANGHAI, 27th November 1931.

Sir,

I have the honour to request you to kindly let me know,
if possible, the address of Mr. J.F.Lavies, a commercial artist
who accompanied by his wife Mrs. C.P.V.Lavies, arrived in
Shanghai from Singapore. in the month of February 1930.

I do not know the nationality of these persons but
judging by their name, they might be of Netherlands or
Belgian nationality.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

R.C.Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

S2
For attention
please.
J.S. Makaroff 28/11/31
O.B.R. 30/11

先生：

本人不知此二人之国籍，但据其姓名判断，可能为荷兰或比利时籍。

Date 23 - 1 - 30

January 23, 30.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. 23 of January 4 and to inform you that enquiries
have failed to reveal the whereabouts of Johannes
Frederik Lavies.

A search of the records of the local office
of the P. & O. Steamship Company shows that Lavies'
name does not appear in the list of passengers who
arrived in Shanghai on the s.s. "Rajputana" in
December 1929.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

N Director of Criminal Investigation.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

1930年1月23日。

先生：

谨此奉复阁下1月4日第23号来函，并告知阁下，经查访未能查明Johannes Frederik Lavies的下落。

经查本地半岛东方轮船公司（P. & O. Steamship Company）办事处记录，Lavies的名字并未出现在1929年12月乘“拉杰普塔纳”号（s.s. "Rajputana"）轮抵达上海的乘客名单中。

此致
敬礼

刑事侦缉处处长 N。

荷兰驻上海总领事

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 846.
Date....23 - 1 - 30.

Despite careful enquiries no trace of Johannes
Frederik Lavies can be found.
Enquiry at the local office of the P. & O.
Shipping Coy shows that no person of that name arrived
in Shanghai in the beginning of December on the s.s.
"Rajputana." Should anything be learned of this person's
whereabouts a report will at once be submitted.

W. Louwman
D. S.

Mr.

尽管经仔细查访，仍未发现Johannes Frederik Lavies的任何踪迹。

SHANGHAI, 4th January 1930.

Sir,

I take the liberty to enquire whether anything
is known to the Police regarding the present where-
abouts of a Netherlands subject Johannes Frederik
LAVIES, who arrived in Shanghai from Singapore in
the beginning of December by the P. & O. s.s.
"Rajputana".

Thanking you in anticipation of your kind atten-
tion to my enquiry,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Den Groeneweg
Consul General.

The Director of Criminal Investigation,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

（批：Foreign Section,
please for inquiry and report
JW
6/1/30.）
